entries.name: Move to pose
entries.description: Moves the robot's TCP to a pose. It plans, validates and executes the motion, and fails when planning, validation or execution fails after any automatic retries. The goal is an absolute pose, or an offset from target_reference when target_mode is relative.

parameters.description: Robot target (component and command target) that the move runs on.
Robot base frame that absolute poses are stated in.
TCP the move uses; omitted means current, the robot's Active TCP.
Pose to reach, with its frame_ref (default the robot base frame); an offset from target_reference when relative.
absolute reaches the stated pose; relative offsets it from target_reference.
Origin of a relative offset: the pose the offset is applied to. Required for relative moves.
Pose whose orientation gives the axes of a relative offset; omitted uses the target_reference orientation.
Planner settings for this move; only the fields set here override the Deployment planner.
Velocity scaling factor, above 0 up to 1; default 1.0.
Acceleration scaling factor, above 0 up to 1; default 1.0.
Per-move TCP linear speed cap in m/s; the lower of this and the Deployment limit applies. Omitted uses the Deployment limit.
Collision clearance in meters for this move, 0 to 0.05. Omitted keeps the Deployment clearance.
Per-joint velocity, acceleration and jerk caps keyed by joint name. Empty means no per-move caps.
Joint tolerance in radians for the start-state check and cached trajectory matching; default 0.05.
Translation tolerance in meters for pose checks in planning and cached trajectory matching; default 0.005.
Rotation tolerance in radians for pose checks in planning and cached trajectory matching; default 0.05.
Seconds allowed for planning before the attempt fails; default 2.0.
Seconds allowed for executing the trajectory before the attempt fails; default 10.0.
default reuses a stored trajectory when it still matches the scene and start state; disable always plans fresh.
Contact policy that makes planning and validation contact-tolerant for this move. Omit for free-space motion.
Scene resource the contact policy applies to. Must be given together with contact_policy_id.
Automatic retries after a planning no-effect or nominal collision stop, 0 to 10; default 3. Zero disables retries.
Seconds to wait before each automatic retry, 0 to 60; default 1.0.
Priority from 0 to 100 for taking over the robot. Equal or higher priority preempts a running move; lower is refused. Default 0.
Node result when this move is preempted or refused by priority: success or failure; default failure.

collision_body_reference.description: Names one collision body of a component by component id and collision body id.

collision_body_id.description: Collision body identifier within the component.

frame_reference.description: Names one frame of a component by component id and frame id.

joint_dynamics_limit.description: Velocity, acceleration and jerk limits for one joint. Each field is optional, and each one that is set must be greater than 0.

max_acceleration_rad_s2.description: Acceleration limit in radians per second squared, above 0 when set.

max_jerk_rad_s3.description: Jerk limit in radians per second cubed, above 0 when set.

max_velocity_rad_s.description: Velocity limit in radians per second, above 0 when set.

motion_pose.description: A target pose for a motion: a position and an orientation, where the orientation is exactly one of xyzw or rpy_deg. When frame_ref is omitted the pose is stated in the moving robot's base frame.

frame_ref.description: Frame the pose is stated in; omitted means the moving robot's base frame.

orientation.description: Exactly one of xyzw or rpy_deg. Required.

position_m.description: Position x, y, z in meters. Required.

motion_reference.description: Names what a motion targets: a component frame or collision body, a scene resource, a runtime object, an absolute pose, or the cell frame. The type decides which other field is required; cell_frame needs none.

body.description: Collision body reference; required for type component_body.

frame.description: Component frame reference; required for type component_frame.

pose.description: Absolute pose; required for type pose.

runtime_object_id.description: Runtime object id, the object bound to a scene resource during a pick; required for type runtime_object.

scene_resource_id.description: Scene resource id; required for type scene_resource.

type.description: component_frame, component_body, scene_resource, runtime_object, pose or cell_frame; each type allows only its matching field.

per_joint_dynamics_limits.description: A map from joint name to joint_dynamics_limit; each key names the joint that the limit applies to.

planner_override.description: Optional per-motion override of the Deployment's RRT planner settings. Only the members that are set replace the Deployment defaults; the others keep their Deployment values.

collision_check_step_rad.description: Collision-check sampling step in radians, above 0 and at most 0.2.

max_nodes.description: Node budget of the RRT search, from 100 to 1000000.

n.description: Number of plans for best_of_n, from 2 to 32. Not used by the other optimize values.

optimize.description: first returns the first path found; rrt_star rewires toward a cheaper path; best_of_n plans n first-path candidates and keeps the shortest.

search.description: rrt or rrt_connect; rrt_connect selects the RRT-Connect search.

pose_frame_ref.description: The frame a stored pose is expressed in: the cell frame, a component target frame, or a scene resource. The kind decides which of the other two fields is required.

frame.description: Component frame reference; required for kind target_frame.

kind.description: cell_frame, target_frame or scene_resource; each kind allows only its matching field.

scene_resource_id.description: Scene resource whose frame is used; required for kind scene_resource.

target_reference.description: Names one command target of a controllable component by component id and command target id.

command_target_id.description: Command target identifier within the component.

tcp_selector.description: Selects the TCP a motion uses: the active TCP held on the blackboard, the default TCP of a command target, or an explicit target and frame. The kind decides which of the other fields apply.

frame.description: Frame used as the TCP; required only for kind entry.

kind.description: current uses the active TCP; default_of_target uses the target's default TCP; entry uses the given target and frame.

target.description: Command target for default_of_target and entry; not allowed for current.
